en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a Baroque church with two ornate towers and a richly decorated façade, standing beside a row of shops and houses along a street. People are walking in front of the buildings and a horse-drawn carriage is visible. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz Pfarrkirche Mariahilf." Storefront signs with German words appear along the ground floor of the adjacent building.
